policy: Mechanism candidates with SPIDER transfer analysis. No mechanism is ADOPT at candidate stage; positive integration status requires reproduction + independent audit (see results/intel/VALIDATED_MECHANISMS.json). Verdicts: EXPERIMENT | WATCH | REJECT | PROMOTED_TO_VALIDATED.

candidates.current_spider_weakness_addressed: robust procedure addressing (paraphrase goals, entry-context mismatch, mid-task state drift); repeated-exploration cost

candidates.mechanism_summary: Capture HAR/network traffic during browser sessions; reverse-engineer first-party API endpoints behind the UI; index as reusable route skills (params/pagination/auth patterns); replay routes directly instead of re-driving a browser; explicit fallback to real browser traversal on miss/stale route; three-tier ladder skill-cache -> shared route graph -> full browser as source of truth with a no-silent-substitution rule during live traversal.
candidates.current_spider_weakness_addressed: product-level need to reduce repeated exploration by changing the execution substrate, not just retrieval; closest public precedent for SPIDER's browser-to-direct-API escalation and shared route registry hypothesis
candidates.minimal_reproduction: Preregistered matched-cost comparison on public sandbox sites: (1) drive browser exploration while capturing HAR/network; (2) reverse-engineer endpoints mechanically from captures; (3) measure replay fidelity, latency and action counts of cached-route execution vs full browser traversal on identical subgoals; (4) characterize staleness/failure modes and fallback behavior; clean-room implementation permitted by MIT license (respect ToS questions around first-party-API replay - flagged unresolved).
candidates.expected_upside_if_real: orders-of-magnitude per-step cost reduction on repeat traffic and an architecture lever beyond the browser instrument
candidates.strongest_null_or_baseline: full browser traversal baseline under identical tasks plus exact fragment/route replay where history exists
candidates.measurement_required: route-discovery success rate; cached-hit latency distribution vs browser-step latency; action/token deltas at matched task success; staleness/failure rate over time; fallback trigger correctness
candidates.integration_cost_and_dependencies: moderate - HAR capture instrumentation exists conceptually in shared layer; endpoint reverse-engineering needs schema inference; ToS/legality review required before any live-site escalation
candidates.contamination_ip_risk: MIT code (friendly); vendor benchmark self-reported; first-party-API replay legality flagged unresolved
candidates.provisional_verdict_detail: EXPERIMENT - selected as next Intel mission (cycle 2)
candidates.provisional_verdict: PROMOTED_TO_VALIDATED (cycle 5; PROOF_OF_CONCEPT ceiling; audit PASS run 32873081963)
candidates.disposition: CLOSED — VALIDATED AND FINAL. Cycle-5 single-host PoC wording remains binding verbatim in results/intel/VALIDATED_MECHANISMS.json. CYCLE 6: multi-host attempt honestly MEASUREMENT_INVALID (PASS run 32897120087). CYCLE 7: valid-but-INCONCLUSIVE clean-instrument confirmation (PASS run 32908028297; family gate zero-power at n=5 by construction). CYCLE 8: powered instrument frozen, power PROVEN numerically in-prereg, audit-verified end-to-end with ZERO observations (PASS run 32931388530). CYCLE 9: confirmatory collection executed under the once-extended CAP => mechanical REPRODUCED_USEFUL (validity+C2'+C3'; sealed-tree speedups 9.40x/5.67x/18.20x/37.46x; Holm p=0.000977 x4; LOHO stable; attribution PARAMETERIZATION_CREDENTIAL_CONTENT); round-0 REVISE defect (undisclosed second collection) repaired documentation-only and closed PASS run 32941504002 (75/75). cycle_9_confirmation block appended to the VALIDATED_MECHANISMS entry with binding dual-collection caveat. THE MULTI-HOST LIVE LINE IS CLOSED PERMANENTLY: the CAP was consumed exactly once; NO further live collection for this mechanism is authorized under any circumstance. Remaining standing obligations are DELIVERABLES-ONLY natural-TTL window-2 executions per both committed protocols (old anchors eligible >=2026-08-26T22:05:30Z and >=2026-08-27T00:30:08Z; own-study anchor policy B eligible >=2026-08-27T06:28:49Z), never verdict input. Successor Intel missions come from the promoted non-live candidates below.

candidates.mechanism_summary: Unsupervised black-box web-API reconstruction from mixed runtime traffic: noise filtering + path normalization then two-stage clustering (interface-shape templates -> graph-based semantic refinement within groups). Reported 95.92% group-accuracy precision / 94.91 F1 across six apps, >10k requests.

candidates.minimal_reproduction: benchmark naive heuristic extraction vs two-stage clustering on captured traffic from a future route-ladder cycle
candidates.expected_upside_if_real: higher discovery fidelity and fewer PARAM_UNRESOLVED/SCHEMA_MISMATCH escalations
candidates.strongest_null_or_baseline: the ladder's current heuristic filter/parameterizer (already SPIDER_REPRODUCED at PoC)
candidates.measurement_required: route-discovery success rate and template correctness per method
candidates.integration_cost_and_dependencies: moderate; algorithm described fully in paper
candidates.revisit_trigger: next route-ladder cycle needs better extraction OR code release

candidates.disposition: PRIORITY 1 SUCCESSOR (promoted per the cycle-8 integration post-closure rule). Design constraints inherited from the audited lineage: reuse the replica-mutation harness methodology (sealed schedule, benign-FP bounding, M4-blindness caveat travels); fixed-TTL and uniform-sweep nulls mandatory; SEP-2549 ttlMs/cacheScope as protocol-native comparator; demoblaze joint etag+hash change-detection rule (cycle-8 Phase-0 environment fact) informs hash-move design.

candidates.mechanism_summary: Per-host versioned contract-profile.json built additively from recorded workflow traffic; later sessions refresh credentials and extend the endpoint set rather than replace; derived artifacts (contract.ts/openapi.json/docs) regenerate from the profile; credentialed replay with auth check --all. Cycle-7 re-verification: credential ledger carries capture-time/expiry/validation status (401/403 invalid, 2xx valid) feeding replay validity plus automated re-auth recapture.
candidates.current_spider_weakness_addressed: alternative retained-object schema to pointer-only route records: additive merge + explicit credential-refresh invalidation story; directly answers the AUTH_FAIL-vs-staleness attribution problem cycle 7 isolated as open (credential lifecycle dimension NOT isolated from response-representation dimension)
candidates.minimal_reproduction: compare replay-validity outcomes with vs without capture-time/expiry/validation-status credential ledger + re-auth recapture on sandbox auth flows; misattribution rate against triage ground truth
candidates.expected_upside_if_real: schema donor: additive recordings may reduce rediscovery cost across sessions on the same host; converts AUTH_FAIL dead-ends into recoverable escalations
candidates.strongest_null_or_baseline: pointer-only route records with static stored credentials as implemented in the audited cycle-5/6/7 harness
candidates.measurement_required: cross-session rediscovery cost and staleness behavior profile-vs-pointer at matched equivalence gates; replay success delta at T+epsilon across session lifetimes
candidates.provisional_verdict: WATCH (upgraded to QUEUED EXPERIMENT, priority-2 successor at cycle-9 integration)
candidates.disposition: QUEUED EXPERIMENT after content-binding freshness control. Relevance UPGRADED by cycle 9: the C3' attribution (PARAMETERIZATION_CREDENTIAL_CONTENT) makes credential-lifecycle handling the measured carrier of capture value over pure declarations - exactly Harpist's ledger dimension. Non-live/sandbox-replica design; answers AUTH_FAIL-vs-staleness attribution that cycles 6-7 left open.
